text:
sam: deploybot flagged a hold for infer-api release. staging vs prod secret format mismatch on INFER_SCOPE. deploybot payload below.

deploybot: /releasecheck failed for infer-api v2.3 -> reason: secret INFER_SCOPE differs between envs. staging='redwood:infer-stg' prod='redwood/infer'. check https://deploychecks.local/3234567890 for details.

miranda: hmm that looks like the legacy colonial vs slash format. we changed the default in canary config last month.

raj: is this critical to runtime or just metadata parsing? if parsing, we could make the service accept both formats in the handler patch and ship, but that's riskier during a release window.

sam: leaning towards backfilling staging to match prod so we don't change runtime behavior mid-rollout. less blast radius. any objections?

linda: I can do the backfill. need the exact secret path + confirmation we copy raw value (not re-encrypt).

sam: deploybot shows path: /keystore/infer/INFER_SCOPE. copy raw value from prod to staging. record in release notes.

miranda: also double-check KMS alias on the secret created; last time we copied we missed alias and staging couldn't decrypt a subset of keys.

linda: ack. running commands now:

linda: ```
# get raw value from prod
kubectl -n prod get secret infer-credentials -o jsonpath='{.data.INFER_SCOPE}' | base64 -d > /tmp/infer_scope.txt
# apply to staging
kubectl -n staging create secret generic infer-credentials --from-file=INFER_SCOPE=/tmp/infer_scope.txt --dry-run=client -o yaml | kubectl apply -f -
```

oncall-bot: added calendar note: release window paused until backfill completes (12:45 UTC).

deploybot: rollout paused by deploybot at 3234567890. re-run /releasecheck after secret sync.

linda: copied value and verified decrypt on a staging pod: `kubectl -n staging exec -it infer-api-5d7b -- curl -s localhost:8080/health | grep OK` -> OK

linda: re-ran /releasecheck -> success. logs: https://deploychecks.local/3234567890/result -> green.

sam: decision: hold was appropriate. backfill done, canary resume. miranda please add a small migration note to the runbook so this format difference is explicit for future releases. raj please verify the handler can tolerate both formats in the next patch.

miranda: will add runbook note and raise an issues/infra ticket to normalize scope parsing.

raj: I'll add guarded parsing in the upcoming patch and add a feature flag. no rollback needed. :thumbsup:

sam: thanks all — resuming canary rollout now.
